verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents a broad API (the DBX Platform) for file storage, sharing, previews, search, and create/read/edit/move/delete file operations. It also offers team namespace listing, webhooks, and multi-language official SDKs. Nothing documents parity with the UI, and many UI features in the pack (Dash AI answers, PDF editing, password-protected files, deleted-file restore, transfers) have no API evidence. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage for Dash, PDF editing, password protection, restore and transfers, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
